subject.title: refactor(channels): move inbound turn execution into core

question: Should shipped reply-dispatcher `onError` callbacks become awaited, or should awaited delivery cleanup be confined to a new internal channel-turn seam?
rationale: The PR preserves declarations but changes observable callback and idle timing for existing Plugin SDK consumers, so the permanent compatibility contract requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Separate internal cleanup
options.body: Preserve the shipped observer timing and add a core-owned awaited cleanup hook used only by assembled channel turn plans.

options.title: Adopt awaited callbacks
options.body: Approve the new serialized callback contract and require compatibility documentation plus live proof showing existing plugin delivery cannot stall.

recommendation.title: Separate internal cleanup
recommendation.body: Preserve the shipped observer timing and add a core-owned awaited cleanup hook used only by assembled channel turn plans.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current-main ownership boundary and authored the follow-up implementation under review.
